title: TOGLL: Correct and Strong Test Oracle Generation with LLMs
datasets: SF110 (110 Java projects) for fine-tuning; OracleEval25 (25 unseen Java projects; 202,434 assertion and 21,123 exception prefixes); Defects4J real-bug oracle study (374 inputs: 304 assertion, 70 exception); PIT mutants across 25 projects (69,793 covered mutants).
task: Generate test oracles for supplied Java test prefixes using prefix/MUT/documentation; measure correctness, diversity, mutation strength and historical Defects4J bug detection. Not issue-to-test generation; test prefixes are given.
input_setting: Paper defines TOGLL as fine-tuned CodeParrot-110M with P6 = prefix + separator + Javadoc + separator + full method under test. It generates assertion/exception oracle without observing runtime behavior.
author_relationship_evidence: The paper says it releases datasets, fine-tuned models and code. Figshare artifact title exactly matches paper; attached author README identifies it as the ICSE’25 artifact and lists RQ1–RQ5 datasets/scripts. Readme PDF md5 5ccd54c1821c4e96d8681c37f049badc; attached license PDF md5 ee4e669f300850b711161e9cb3bf3a4c.
source_commit_or_archive: Figshare v3, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.28282721.v3; archive togll-artifacts.zip (7,155,500,527 bytes; MD5 ab3ef50552982adc2efc721cb6ea7e3a). HTTP Range ZIP64 central-directory inspection; no full archive download or extraction.
license: Figshare attached license states artifact under ODbL 1.0 and individual database contents under Database Contents License 1.0. No distinct permissive software license was verified for the bundled Python source; check conditions before reuse.
exact_models: Main TOGLL: fine-tuned codeparrot/codeparrot-small-multi (110M), P6; paper compares CodeGen-350M and six other code LLMs across prompts.
RQ5 archive model config identifies codeparrot/codeparrot-small-multi, GPT2LMHeadModel, Transformers 4.37.2.
weights_status: Fine-tuned checkpoint is publicly bundled: RQ5 model/TOGLL/model.safetensors, ZIP central directory uncompressed size 444,048,000 bytes; RQ2 CodeParrot checkpoint files are also present. Checkpoint is confirmed by archive metadata, not downloaded or loaded.
evaluation_route: Artifact README lists exact versioned Python dependencies, RQ1 training/data scripts, RQ2 inference and projects, RQ4 project/test suites + PIT, and RQ5 Defects4J resources/TOGA regeneration/oracle scripts. Static source was range-read (prepare_defects4j_inputs.py, inference.py, dataset_bf.py, utils.py, fine_tune_code_parrot.py, pyproject.toml); no code was run. The RQ5 inference script selects tc_mut and local model codeparrot_tc_mut, while paper’s headline TOGLL uses P6 and bundled checkpoint directory is named TOGLL; resolve this path/prompt mismatch before claiming exact replay. Dependencies include Python>=3.11, Transformers 4.36.1, Torch 2.1.2, Accelerate .25, DeepSpeed .13.2; README says Java 8+21/Maven/Docker/PIT for evaluation and paper describes 4xA100 for full fine-tuning. No API/model calls.
blockers: Archive is very large (6.66 GiB; 7,155,500,527-byte ZIP); inspection was remote-range metadata/source reading, not full download.

RQ5 source defaults to tc_mut and model codeparrot_tc_mut, differing from paper-defined P6 and bundled RQ5/TOGLL checkpoint path; exact real-bug replay requires resolving this apparent artifact-script/config mismatch.
Full training of seven models and six prompts is compute-heavy (paper uses 4xA100); fine-tuned TOGLL checkpoint is bundled, so targeted inference/evaluation may avoid retraining.
Java/Maven/Docker/PIT environment and Defects4J/TOGA setup required.
No exact author-code run was performed; attached ODbL/DBCL terms and lack of distinct code license should be reviewed before reuse.
concept_fit: High oracle-quality prior work: separates oracle correctness from strength; P6 uses documentation and MUT code. Does not provide a causal concept taxonomy or generate test prefixes; only oracle completion for provided prefixes.
recommendation: Keep as a strong oracle-generation baseline and methodological reference for checking correctness, false positives, mutation strength and real historical bugs. Among 2025 papers, the small 110M model and bundled checkpoint make it unusually accessible, but first resolve the P6 vs tc_mut RQ5 artifact mismatch. It is not a direct concept-guided issue-reproduction baseline.
supporting_locations: Full paper §§I–VI and appendices/references in paper_fulltext.txt (11,131 words; SHA-256 6b39c09098f8c16e256dbf63b3c680be0c0e37d12d93c476b42d8ef5b61f9f72).
artifact-readme.pdf sections 1–4 and artifact-license.pdf; checksums recorded above.

Remote ZIP central directory confirms TOGLL model.safetensors (444,048,000 bytes uncompressed), RQ1/RQ2/RQ5 inference/training source and Defects4J scripts. Relevant static source excerpt and discrepancy notes: public_evidence/source-audit.json.
